stem: In what way are the portrait of George Washington and the book The Silmarillion similar?

options.label: F
options.text: Each earned a great amount of money for its creator.

options.label: G
options.text: Each remained incomplete at the time of its creator's death.

options.label: H
options.text: Each was included in a larger body of work that its creator had made.

options.label: J
options.text: Each required that people other than its creator work on it.
